data.title: 02 · 海风里的彩色糖果
data.description: 【海边旧码头·正午】02穿着红白泳装盘腿坐在旧码头边，手里抓着一串彩色糖果；她用脚尖踢起水花，粉发被风吹得乱七八糟，转头朝镜头做出得意鬼脸，像把整个夏天都占为己有。
data.action: 旧码头边踢水花吃彩色糖果，迎风乱发后对镜头做得意鬼脸
data.lighting: crisp noon light with turquoise reflections
data.mood: 把夏日当成私人舞台的活力少女
data.promptProse: Zero Two sits at the old seaside pier in her red-and-white sailor swimsuit and loose white overshirt, holding a string of colorful sweets beside the candy pouch. She shifts one leg to kick the water and turns toward the viewer with a proud grimace, pink hair wind-tossed. The horizontal medium view includes weathered boards and turquoise water below. Crisp noon light brightens striped socks and sweets, with water reflections beneath the pier edge.
